newsitem.title: USA: NCS Healthcare buys Valley Pharmaceutical.
newsitem.headline: NCS Healthcare buys Valley Pharmaceutical.

text.p: NCS HealthCare Inc said on Wednesday it acquired California-based Valley Pharmaceutical Services, which provides institutional pharmacy and related services, for undisclosed terms.
Valley served over 2,600 residents of long-term care facilities and several thousand mental health patients, and had annual revenues of about $6.7 million, NCS said.

NCS HealthCare president Kevin Shaw said: "With the purchase of Valley, we've entered a new geographic area in a state NCS already serves." Valley had a strong presence in northern California, the company said.
